widget_mechanic: Calendar opens on current month; agent must click the next-month arrow N times to reach target month, then click the target date cell. The default 'do nothing' leaves the calendar at the current month, producing dates near today (wrong).

primary_inspiration.instruction: Book a flight with KLM from Lagos, Nigeria to Frankfurt, Germany flying out 07/17/2026 and coming back 07/25/2026. If there are no available flights for those dates, please indicate that in your answer.
primary_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Calendar — agent did not advance the single-month picker forward from the default month and never landed on July 17, 2026.
